name: westwood_online_upgrade_progress_dialog_scalar_dtor
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog::ScalarDeletingDestructor calls the progress dialog destructor, conditionally deletes storage when flag bit 0 is set, and returns this.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja disassembly for 0x442240 validates a compiler-generated scalar deleting destructor that calls the implicit WestwoodOnlineUpgradeProgressDialog destructor, tests deleteFlags bit 0, calls imported operator delete only for that bit, returns self in eax, and returns with 4-byte stack cleanup.

Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_progress_dialog_scalar_dtor_smoke patches imported MFC42 CDialog::~CDialog and verifies both stack/no-delete and heap/delete paths call the underlying destructor exactly once and return the original object pointer.
